# Class: `InpSettingsCommand`

Restores before/after analysis choices through the panel's undo stack.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-inptk-panel.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_panel.py#L40) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QUndoCommand`.

The first redo does nothing because the edit has already been applied. Later undo and redo calls restore their respective choice snapshots.
